about.metaDescription: Tortkara Machinery LLP — 5 years on the market. Lease of rotary drilling and pile-driving equipment: 30% down, up to 3 years. Almaty.
about.title: About the company
about.lead: Rotary drilling and pile-driving equipment for lease, matched to your site: we select the machine, agree the terms, and get it onto the pad.
about.storyTitle: Your partner for drilling and pile-driving rigs
about.storyImageAlt: XCMG rotary drilling rig on site
about.storyP1: Tortkara Machinery LLP — 5 years on the market. We work with construction and infrastructure contractors on XCMG, BAUER and SANY rotary drilling and pile-driving equipment — new and used.
about.storyP2: Our goal is a clear deal and a rig that goes to work quickly. Reach us by phone, WhatsApp or Instagram — from the first consultation to handover.
about.storyP3: Need a model outside the catalog — note it in the application: we will select a drilling or pile-driving rig for your job and budget.
about.advantageText: We lease not only new but also used rotary drilling and pile-driving equipment — a rare option on the market. Get on site faster without paying the full machine price upfront.
about.pillarsTitle: From application to equipment on site

pillars.title: Request and scope
pillars.text: Describe the site and the machine you need — new or used, drilling or pile-driving. We reply within a business day.

pillars.title: Selection and quote
pillars.text: We match depth, diameter and budget. Calculation: 30% down payment, term up to 3 years.

pillars.title: Agreement
pillars.text: We assemble documents and agree a lease with a clear payment schedule.

pillars.title: Handover
pillars.text: After completion the equipment is handed over to your company — ready for work.

about.officeText: A local office and steady contact. Lease terms, documents and delivery handled in one place.
about.ctaText: Specify the model (new or used, drilling or pile-driving) and your contacts. We will prepare a calculation and follow up.
about.leaseOfferTitle: Lease for new and used equipment
about.leaseOfferP1: Tortkara Machinery offers competitive lease terms for rotary drilling and pile-driving rigs with full deal support: from consultation and paperwork to equipment handover.
about.leaseOfferP2: A key advantage is access to used rotary drilling and pile-driving rigs under a standard lease program. That means proven machines on clear terms without hunting for special financing schemes.
about.leaseOfferP3: We work with leading leasing companies in Kazakhstan to match financing terms and keep applications moving quickly.
leaseOfferTerms: lease for new and used equipment
about.leaseOfferClose: Leasing helps preserve working capital, acquire equipment without a large upfront outlay, and spread the financial load across construction and infrastructure projects.
